# scaffolding_node_network_interface (Resource)

Manages a single Proxmox VE host network interface (`/nodes/{node}/network`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `iface` (String) Interface name (Linux device name or alias).
- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node.
- `type` (String) Interface type. Must be one of: `eth`, `bond`, `bridge`, `vlan`, `ovsbond`, `ovsbridge`, `ovsintport`, `ovsport`, `unknown`. Changing the type forces replacement because PVE rewrites the underlying device on type change.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Plain IP address (with mask as a separate field on the wire).
- `autostart` (Boolean) Bring the interface up automatically on boot. Defaults to `true`.
- `bond_mode` (String) Linux kernel bonding driver mode. Must be one of: `balance-rr`, `active-backup`, `balance-xor`, `broadcast`, `802.3ad`, `balance-tlb`, `balance-alb`.
- `bond_primary` (String) Primary bond slave.
- `bridge_fd` (Number) Bridge forward delay in seconds. Must be between 0 and 15 inclusive.
- `bridge_ports` (String) Comma-separated list of member interfaces (bridge type).
- `bridge_stp` (Boolean) Enable spanning tree protocol on the bridge.
- `cidr` (String) CIDR-notation address for the interface (alias form).
- `comments` (String) Free-form text shown in the UI.
- `delete` (List of String) Field names to clear from PVE on the next update (translated to the `delete` query parameter).
- `gateway` (String) Default gateway for IPv4 traffic.
- `method` (String)
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum transmission unit in bytes. Must be between 576 and 65535 inclusive (Linux kernel networking range).
- `ovs_bridge` (String) OVS bridge this interface belongs to.
- `ovs_options` (Map of String) Extra OVS options (e.g. `tag=10`).
- `ovs_type` (String) OVS port type. Must be one of: `internal`, `native`, `trunk`, `access`, `patch`.
- `slaves` (List of String) Member interfaces of a bond.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN tag (vlan type only). Must be between 0 and 4094 inclusive (IEEE 802.1Q range).
- `vlan_raw_device` (String) Underlying device the VLAN sits on (vlan type only).

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the interface is currently active in the kernel.
- `digest` (String) Opaque PVE digest (not used for network updates; populated for parity with other resources).
